Seasoned business development professional focused on building B2B pipelines, implementing CRM-driven processes, and closing strategic accounts.

Business Development Manager, Covalent Infotech
Feb 2023 - Jul 2026
Led enterprise outreach and commercial negotiation for a portfolio of mid-market clients. Designed a CRM-based opportunity qualification framework and migrated regional pipeline tracking into Salesforce, improving forecast accuracy and deal velocity. Coordinated technical pre-sales and handoff using Confluence pages and Jira tickets to track implementation readiness. Generated and qualified inbound and outbound leads through targeted campaigns; closed several accounts with average contract value growth of 18% year-over-year. Regularly used SFDC for opportunity management and pipeline reporting.

Business Development Manager, CartNest
Sep 2020 - Jan 2023
Owned end-to-end B2B Sales cycle for SaaS offerings targeting e-commerce retailers. Built and executed Lead Generation programs including targeted outreach and demo cadences, resulting in a steady increase in SQLs. Implemented CRM best practices and standardized opportunity stages in Salesforce to reduce sales cycle time. Collaborated with product and engineering teams via Confluence and Jira to prioritize client feature requests and track delivery. Used SFDC daily for pipeline hygiene and forecasting.

B2B Sales, SFDC, Lead Generation, CRM, Confluence, Jira, Git
